title: PalmX-Hub: analysis code for haplotype-resolved genomes and a population pangenome of oil palm
description: Analysis and figure-generation code for the oil palm (Elaeis guineensis) haplotype-resolved genome, pangenome, population genomics, structural variation, multi-omics, single-nucleus RNA-seq and allele-specific expression study. No data are included; see the Data availability statement of the paper.
